newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance Cosmetics to restate earnings.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance Cosmetics to restate earnings.

text.p: Renaissance Cosmetics, Inc said on Tuesday it planned to restate its previously- reported results for the six months ended September 30, 1996 and September 30, 1995.
The company said it decided to defer recognition of certain sales from the second fiscal quarter until the third quarter ended December 31 in each year.
Renaissance said it would also restate its previously reported balance sheet data as of September 30, 1996 and September 30, 1995.
Renaissance makes, markets and distributes frangrances, cosmetics and related products. Its brands included "Chantilly," "English Leather" and "NaVy."

The restatement would result in about $3.3 million of previously reported net sales and about $1.2 million of related EBITDA, or earnings before interest, income taxes, depreciation and amortization for the six months ended September 30, 1996 being reported in the third quarter.
About $1.9 million of previously reported net sales and about $747,000 of related EBITDA for the six months ended September 30, 1995, would also be recorded in the third quarter 1995, it said.
The restatement relates to certain products that were shipped from the company's facilities to a third party packer's warehouse before September 30 in each of the two years, it said.
